resources.string: Automatically reconnect to target device. Note: App constantly tries to find and connect.
Keep a persistent notification running in background to ensure Android OS does not put Wireless Start app in battery optimization mode. Recommended if Auto Connect is enabled.
The stop relay acts as a safety loop, allowing the vehicle to start only when energized. Disabling this tells the ESP32 controller not to energize the stop relay during boot.
Automatically start the engine based on your configured time. Note: Currently this is only available on Watch App.
Configure START engine pulse duration. Default is 1 second.
Configure STOP engine pulse duration. Default is 4 second.
Toggle Live Battery Voltage ON and OFF. This feature may not be available.
